topic: Barker's February 11, 2018 generating-function and recurrence conjectures in OEIS A299285 and A299286 for the tea uniform tiling
title: Proof of Barker's tea-tiling conjectures: OEIS A299285–A299286, FORMULA (February 11, 2018)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Colin Barker's generating-function and recurrence conjectures of February 11, 2018 in the FORMULA fields of OEIS A299285 and A299286 for the tea uniform tiling. An exact distance formula reduces its graph spheres to integer hexagons in triangular layers. Their counts give a quadratic quasipolynomial of least period four, establish Stefano Spezia's conditional formula of June 8, 2024, and give the corresponding cubic ball count. We also prove that the proposed recurrences have the least possible eventual orders, six and seven. The same layer count proves the companion tcd formulas in A299287 and A299288. For arbitrary orientations of the tetrahedron–octahedron slabs, the tcd and tea counts are sharp lower and upper bounds, with sphere-count gap floor(n^2/8).
summary: For n>0, tea spheres satisfy 8a(n)=63n^2+c(n mod 4), c=(16,17,12,17). The note proves the sphere and ball formulas for tea and tcd, least recurrence orders and periods, and sharp bounds with equality conditions for arbitrary orientations of their alternating special and prism slabs.
